paper: ATLAS: Adaptive Trading with LLM AgentS Through Dynamic Prompt Optimization and Multi-Agent Coordination
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock implementation of ATLAS's three analysts, Central Trading Agent, fixed execution interface, and delayed-window Adaptive-OPRO instruction updates; not a StockSim precursor replay or native LLM prompt trajectory.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Market, news, and fundamental analyst agents prepare structured information for a Central Trading Agent that consumes portfolio state and emits executable order-level decisions.
Adaptive-OPRO maintains the current static instruction and scored prompt history, then uses the latest delayed outcome summary to write the next instruction.
Only static policy instructions may change; dynamic analyst inputs, state placeholders, output schema, and execution interface remain fixed.

primary_source_anchors.anchor: Section 4, Windowed evaluation and ATLAS instantiation, equation 1
primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Every five decisions, realized cumulative ROI is mapped to clip(50 + 250 times ROI, 0, 100), and a newly accepted prompt governs only subsequent unreplayed decisions.

adaptive_opro_policy.window_roi_proxy: compound five monthly equal-weight long-short analyst-score decile returns without costs, computed only after every return realizes
adaptive_opro_policy.meta_update: add 0.25 times the cross-analyst z-score of standalone window ROI to log analyst weights and softmax
adaptive_opro_policy.selectivity_update: raise the hold threshold by 0.05 when feedback is below 50, otherwise lower it by 0.02, within frozen bounds
adaptive_opro_policy.fixed_output_schema: continuous score plus BUY when above threshold, SELL below negative threshold, otherwise HOLD
adaptive_opro_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the continuous order-aware score enters frozen value-weighted long-short deciles and all six cost/missing-return paths

preserved_elements: three specialized market, news, and fundamental analysts
a Central Trading Agent that synthesizes analyst outputs
an order-aware buy, hold, and sell interface
the static instruction as the optimized object
strict separation of editable static policy from fixed dynamic inputs and schema
the exact clip(50 + 250 times ROI, 0, 100) feedback score
optimization history of prompt versions and scores
a newly written prompt applied only to subsequent decisions
no replay of prior windows under later prompts
approximated_elements: JKP technical ranks replace multiscale chart and indicator summaries
earnings/sales surprises and attention replace structured news reports
JKP value and quality replace corporate report summaries
analyst weights and selectivity threshold replace natural-language CTA instructions
a deterministic performance-attribution update replaces the optimizer LLM meta-prompt
monthly decisions replace daily order generation
a simple long-short ROI proxy replaces StockSim order-level window scoring
invented_elements: the exact signed JKP analyst features
equal initial analyst weights and 0.10 hold threshold
the threshold update increments and 0.00/0.40 bounds
cross-analyst ROI z-scores as the prompt-edit diagnosis
